title: WATCHER / KINETIC PORTRAIT
core_formula: ordinary / discarded components -> intervention -> behavior -> collectible object
core_lesson: DON'T DECORATE THE FOUND OBJECT - MUTATE ITS PURPOSE.
summary: A rough painted portrait becomes a physical interactive artifact. A hidden ESP32 / sensor / servo mechanism makes the eyes react to a person.
learn: Give static found objects unexpected behavior.
Behavior can be the design, not an extra feature.
Exposed mechanics can become part of the aesthetic.
source: user-provided PDF: Картина с движущимися глазами .pdf
